parameters.command: HRM_FILE=`ls -t /backups/sql/hrm_dump_*.sql 2>/dev/null | head -1` && AI_FILE=`ls -t /backups/sql/hrm_ai_dump_*.sql 2>/dev/null | head -1` && if [ -z "$HRM_FILE" ] || [ -z "$AI_FILE" ]; then echo "SQL_RESTORE_FAILED:Khong_tim_thay_file_backup"; exit 1; fi && echo "Restoring hrm from: $HRM_FILE" && docker exec hrm-database psql -U postgres -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='hrm' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid();" && docker exec hrm-database psql -U postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS hrm;" && docker exec hrm-database psql -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE hrm;" && docker exec -i hrm-database psql -U postgres -d hrm < "$HRM_FILE" && echo "Restoring hrm_ai from: $AI_FILE" && docker exec hrm-database psql -U postgres -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='hrm_ai' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid();" && docker exec hrm-database psql -U postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS hrm_ai;" && docker exec hrm-database psql -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE hrm_ai;" && docker exec -i hrm-database psql -U postgres -d hrm_ai < "$AI_FILE" && echo "SQL_RESTORE_SUCCESS:$HRM_FILE,$AI_FILE" || echo "SQL_RESTORE_FAILED"

parameters.text:
